featured_reviews.name: Sakib Mulla
featured_reviews.review_text:
🥛 Parsi Dairy Farm (Est. 1916): A Testament to Purity
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ An Uncompromising Pillar of Mumbai's Culinary Tradition
Parsi Dairy Farm is not merely a sweet shop; it is a gastronomic institution and a tangible link to Mumbai’s rich Parsi and Gujarati dairy heritage. Established in 1916, this centenary establishment embodies an unwavering commitment to purity and age-old methods, standing proudly against modern industrial practices.
Their specialization is milk elevated to an art form. The legendary Malai Kulfi is essential—rich, dense, and incomparable in texture and flavor. During season, the traditional, hand-churned Sancha Ice Cream is a must-try, offering a taste of dairy that is increasingly rare. Traditionalists will also value their high-grade Ghee and delicate Saffron Petha.
You must be prepared for premium pricing, but you are investing in unmatched quality and a dedication to ingredients that few other places can claim. The no-frills, transaction-focused setting perfectly underscores their mission: the product speaks for itself.
For the definitive, authentic taste of classic Mumbai confectionery and dairy excellence, Parsi Dairy Farm is an essential stop. A perfect 5/5 for tradition, purity, and taste.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Deeply appreciate your thoughtful words - honored to be recognized for our commitment to tradition, purity, and timeless quality.

featured_reviews.name: Ashish Choadhry
featured_reviews.review_text:
An old establishment from 1916 and still continuing its legacy. Visited the Princess Street outlet with is probably the first outlet of their.
Their have own dairy products like Ghee, Kulfi, Milk, Sweets and chocolates. We tried the traditional malai kulfi and trust me it's very nice. They offer seven flavours in kulfi apart from several sweets and other dairy products.
They also have the traditional milk chocolate which is a favourite amongst kids. They also have ghee, butter etc.
The outlet stands out due to the lively colours used in the branding. They have kept old memorabilia which is also used for decorative displays and other purposes. Loved the idea of old milk cans used as seating stools. Displays old coupons which were exchanged daily when milk was supplied to the customer. The measures used for milk, old milk cans, coupon books etc are all treasures and the present generation must definitely have a look at them. More than an outlet, it also doubles up as a museum too.

The quality of the products is extremely good and the place is very clean and hygienic. This place is definitely a must visit whenever you are in Mumbai.

Staff is also very friendly and good. All the best.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you for the fantastic review! we are thrilled to hear that you are enjoying it. Thanks again for the support.

customer_updates.name: Gaurav Tayade
customer_updates.text:
K. Rustom & Co. is not just an ice cream parlour — it’s a slice of Mumbai’s history, nostalgia, and sweetness served between two wafer biscuits. Located right opposite Marine Drive, this humble little shop has been delighting generations of Mumbaikars long before fancy dessert chains took over the city. Walking into K. Rustom’s feels like stepping back in time, where simplicity, tradition, and genuine flavor still matter.
The moment you enter, you’re greeted by a display filled with colorful ice cream sandwiches stacked neatly in their signature paper wraps. There’s no loud décor, neon lights, or Instagram aesthetic — and that’s exactly the charm of this place. It has retained its old-world authenticity over the decades, focusing purely on what truly matters: great taste and generous portions at affordable prices.
The menu may look simple, but every flavor carries its own personality. From classic favorites like strawberry, vanilla, and chocolate to more unique ones like walnut crunch, rum and raisin, raspberry ripple, and kesar pista — each scoop has a distinct richness. The ice cream is perfectly firm, creamy yet light, and the wafer adds that satisfying crunch which makes every bite nostalgic.
One of my personal favorites is their Walnut Crunch — it’s rich, nutty, and has that perfect balance of sweetness without being overpowering. The Rum and Raisin flavor, too, stands out with its mature taste and smooth texture. Even their Mango and Pineapple flavors are fresh and fruity, reminding you of homemade ice creams made with love.
What makes K. Rustom’s truly special, though, is the experience that surrounds it. You grab your ice cream sandwich, step outside, and just a few steps away is the iconic Marine Drive promenade. Sitting by the sea, enjoying the breeze, and relishing that cold, creamy delight as waves crash nearby — it’s a feeling that no modern dessert café can replicate. It’s Mumbai in its purest form — simple joys in a chaotic city.
Another reason people love K. Rustom’s is their consistency. They’ve been serving quality ice creams for decades, and despite the growing popularity, they haven’t changed their style or pricing drastically. The service is quick, the staff polite, and everything runs with quiet efficiency — just like it always has.
If you’re visiting Mumbai or even if you’ve lived here all your life, K. Rustom & Co. deserves a spot on your must-visit list. It’s a reminder that some things never need to change to stay perfect.
In a world of gourmet desserts and Instagram cafés, K. Rustom’s remains refreshingly old-fashioned — and that’s exactly what makes it legendary. A scoop of nostalgia, a dash of heritage, and a lot of happiness — that’s what every visit feels like. ❤️

featured_reviews.name: Sangeerthana R
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited K. Rustom & Co Ice Cream Parlour near Churchgate, and it was a delightful experience that felt both nostalgic and satisfying. The place has an old-world charm that immediately stands out. From the simple setup to the long-standing reputation, everything about it feels rooted in tradition rather than trends.
The ice cream sandwiches are clearly the highlight here, and they did not disappoint. I tried a classic combination, and the thick, creamy ice cream paired with soft wafers tasted incredibly rich and fresh. The flavors are straightforward but very well done, without being overly sweet. You can tell that the focus is on quality rather than variety or presentation.
What I really liked was the no-frills approach of the place. There is no seating or fancy décor, yet people patiently line up just for the taste. Watching customers from different age groups enjoying their ice creams made the visit feel warm and familiar. It is one of those places where the experience is as much about the memory as it is about the food.
Overall, K. Rustom & Co is a must-visit if you are in Mumbai. It offers simple, honest ice cream and leaves you with a smile and a sense of nostalgia.

would love to visit this place again.

featured_reviews.name: Govind Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
K. Rustom & Co. is not just an ice cream parlour—it’s a timeless Mumbai experience that perfectly blends nostalgia, simplicity, and great taste. Located near Churchgate Station, opposite the Ambassador Hotel, this iconic spot has been serving its legendary ice cream sandwiches since 1953, and it truly lives up to its reputation.
The highlight here is undoubtedly their signature ice cream sandwiches—thick, creamy slabs of ice cream pressed between crisp wafer biscuits. The texture is rich and smooth, never icy, and the flavours are honest, balanced, and not overly sweet. We tried a variety of flavours including Walnut Crunch, Coffee, Kesar Pista, Pista, Vanilla, Choco Crunch, Candied Cream, and Chocolate Almond. Chocolate Almond and Walnut Crunch stood out as absolute favourites, while Coconut Pista felt slightly below average. Each flavour tasted true to its name, showcasing quality over gimmicks.
What makes K. Rustom & Co. special is its no-frills, old-world charm. There’s no fancy décor or seating—just a simple setup where people from all age groups patiently queue up for a taste of nostalgia. The service is quick and efficient, even during peak hours, though it can feel a bit rushed due to the crowd. The place is often busy, especially in the evenings and on weekends, which only proves its enduring popularity.
Prices are very reasonable considering the quality and legacy. Do note that the outlet accepts cash only, so it’s best to come prepared. There’s no parking, no photography allowed inside, and occasionally some flavours may be unavailable—but these minor inconveniences are easy to overlook once you take that first bite.
Overall, K. Rustom & Co. offers simple, authentic ice cream with a strong emotional connect. It’s perfect for a quick dessert after a walk at Marine Drive or for introducing visitors to a true taste of Mumbai’s culinary heritage. Not fancy, not modern—just classic, comforting, and memorable. A must-visit for every dessert lover in Mumbai. 🍨✨

featured_reviews.name: Merlin
featured_reviews.review_text: K. Rustom & Co. is one of Mumbai's most iconic old-school ice cream parlours, located near Churchgate. Established in 1953, it is best known for its signature ice cream sandwiches tucked between thin wafer biscuits. They offer classic flavors like vanilla and chocolate along with favorites such as mango, raspberry, and butterscotch each bite tasting nostalgic and timeless. The place carries a charming vintage vibe and is perfect for a quick sweet stop after a walk at Marine Drive. Prices are reasonable, but there's no seating available, and you can usually expect a bit of waiting time due to its popularity. They do not accept card or online payments, it’s cash only, so make sure to carry cash before visiting.

featured_reviews.name: Tanmay Ayare
featured_reviews.review_text:
K. Rustom & Co. – A Mumbai Classic Ice Cream That Never Disappoints

Location - Near Churchgate Station, opposite Ambassador Hotel, Mumbai

Stepping into K. Rustom & Co. is like taking a trip back in time and every bite of their iconic ice cream sandwiches takes you even further. A true Mumbai institution, this old-school parlour continues to win hearts with its unique charm and legendary flavours.

What We Tried

We ate a delicious range of flavours:

- Walnut Crunch – nutty, creamy, and perfectly balanced

- Coffee – subtle, strong, and not overly sweet

- Candied Cream – fun, nostalgic. Kids would love it

- Pista – smooth and mildly flavoured

- Choco Crunch – rich chocolate with bits of crunch that added great texture

- Paan – surprisingly refreshing with just the right hit of paan essence

All of them were served between their signature thin wafer biscuits, making it easy to eat (and very photogenic!). The texture is dense yet smooth, and each flavour felt true to its name.

Price & Experience

Prices are very affordable, especially considering how unique and satisfying the product is. Do note: it’s cash-only and no seating, but that’s part of the charm.

Service is quick and straightforward. You queue up, pick your flavour, pay, and step outside most likely with a smile.

Verdict

K. Rustom & Co. is not just an ice cream parlour, it's a Mumbai experience.
If you're near Marine Drive or Churchgate, make this a stop. Perfect for a post-walk treat or to introduce visitors to a taste of Mumbai's legacy.

Don’t visit Mumbai without stopping here.

featured_reviews.name: Abhishek Solanki
featured_reviews.review_text:
I first went here in Mar'20 just before COVID-19 hit and now in Oct'25. I was glad that it hadn't been shut down like many eateries of its size.
The quality is the same as before - excellent. The ambience is the same - fun. The people there know their stuff (I was very nicely explained that my original choice of ice-cream and sauces for my waffle would not go well together). The owner was warm and respectful. Definitely a place to visit again and again 🐧
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you sir 😊

featured_reviews.name: Decorate The Platter
featured_reviews.review_text:
A small outlet in marine lines which is known for its fast food and moreover their delicious desserts.

We tried,

Fully loaded Pizza :- Now that's very unique! It doesn't have a normal pizza base but a khichiya as it's base and all the delicious toppings of a pizza are scattered over it and that just tastes even more amazing.

Strawberry ice cream:- They make ice-creams at their outlet themselves and I can surely say that they are one of the best ice cream makers. The strawberry ice cream was just so perfect with proper sweetness, there were a few strawberry pieces too!

The ambience is very soothing and a very good place.

Must try.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: we're glad you enjoyed

featured_reviews.name: Nadeem Sayed
featured_reviews.review_text: Wow what a place to eat ice cream. Lovely flavors. Having ice cream here is fun. They keep on inventing new flavors. There are many other things to try from their menu. Chipotle khichya, loaded pizza, exiler, waffles, falooda, and many many more thing to have. The staff is excellent and has a good knowledge of their menu. Very cooperative and nice.must try place.
